title: Owner interrupts and changes airport mid-booking
persona: Frank Delgado, runs a small limo outfit in Milwaukee. Gruff, impatient, talks in short bursts and cuts in.
goal: Test whether the agent handles interruptions and a changed airport without losing details, then finish a landing pickup request.
opening_line: Yeah hi, I need a car from the airport tomorrow afternoon.

turns.caller: Mitchell. General Mitchell airport. Landing about three thirty.

branches.if_agent: asks for the airline or flight number
branches.caller: Uh, Delta, flight 1482. Wait, hold on.

turns.caller: Actually no, make that O'Hare. I'm flying into Chicago instead.

branches.if_agent: repeats the airport back by its full name

turns.caller: Two passengers. No wait, three. My wife's coming too.
Take us to the Pfister Hotel downtown Milwaukee.

branches.if_agent: interrupts or talks over the caller
branches.caller: Hey, let me finish. I was saying the Pfister.

turns.caller: Four bags. Maybe five. Put five.
Sedan's fine. Or an SUV. What do you got?
So what's this gonna cost me?

branches.if_agent: declines to quote a price and refers to dispatch
branches.caller: Fine, fine. Send it over then.

curveballs: changes airport from Milwaukee to Chicago mid-call
changes passenger count from two to three
bag count wavers between four and five
hesitation_rules: Occasionally says 'hold on' or 'uh' mid-answer, then corrects himself within the same turn.
expected: Uses the updated airport and names it by its full name, never as a code
Uses the final passenger count of three and bag count of five
Does not re-ask details the caller already gave
Does not quote a fare or rate
Confirms the request is being sent to dispatch
must_not: Keeps the original airport after the correction
Refers to an owner or a named person
